# Oscura

Oscura is a dark theme the description traces to oscura-vim, built on a palette intended for comfortable long-term use. It tunes syntax highlighting for code blocks and inline code and keeps a minimal UI with consistent colors for comments, keywords, functions, strings and links.

![Oscura screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vinitkumar/oscura-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Oscura"
    author: "vinitkumar"
    repo:   "vinitkumar/oscura-obsidian"
    slug:   "oscura"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/oscura"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/vinitkumar/oscura-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vinitkumar/oscura-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dark, elegant theme inspired by oscura-vim with a carefully crafted palette for comfortable long-term use. Enjoy optimized syntax highlighting for code blocks and inline code plus a clean, minimal UI with consistent colors for comments, keywords, functions, strings and links."
}
```
